## Proposed change
Describe exactly what changes and why.

## B.E.N. Test / impact
- [ ] Leaves things better and puts people before ego
- [ ] Respects dissent, access, privacy and context
- [ ] Adds value beyond what it takes (including environmental cost)
- [ ] Reversible where practicable; documented handover
- [ ] No moral scores or automatic sanctions

## Source and status
- Sources / versions:
- Draft vs adopted status:
- Policy `DEC-` ID if required (otherwise explain why not):
- Owner / unconflicted reviewer(s):

## Technical verification
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] UI/manual check completed
- [ ] No private casework, secrets, membership identifiers or consent records
- [ ] No unreviewed external action
- [ ] Public deployment reviewed separately if relevant

> PR review is not itself a B.E.N. Board vote.
